UK sizes changed (e.g. XXS was UK 6 → 4-6, L was UK 14 → 14-16, XL 16 → 18-20). The old /help-size-guide URLs no longer resolve.

audit: Was 6 rows 'XS (EU 34)'–'XXL (EU 44)' with single values, one EU size per letter and US sizes. Official chart is letter sizes XS–L only, each spanning two EU/UK sizes (XS = EU 32–34 / UK 4–6 … L = EU 44–46 / UK 16) with cm ranges (e.g. M chest 92–96, waist 76–80, hip 100–104; old M was bust 90/waist 72/hips 95). No US sizes and no XL/XXL on the official chart.

Old figures were 2–5 cm low at the small end and stopped at UK 20: UK 4 bust 75→80, waist 57→62, hips 81→88; UK 8 bust 83→85; UK 12 bust 91→95, waist 73→77; UK 20 bust 111→117. Official Main Range chart runs UK 4–32 (added UK 22–32). For UK 32 the official table repeats the UK 30 conversions (US 26, EU 58), which looks like a site error, so US/EU are left out for that row only. Old /page/size-guide.html redirects to /pages/informational/size-guide.

Was 6 letter rows XS–XXL (UK 8–18) with figures not on the official chart. Coast now publishes numeric UK 4–24 only: e.g. UK 8 bust 83→85, waist 63→67, hips 88→93; UK 12 bust 90→95, waist 70→77, hips 95→103; UK 18 bust 107→111, hips 112→119. US/EU from Coast's own conversion table. Site moved from coast-stores.com to coastfashion.com (old /size-guide is a 404).

UK 6–12 were correct. UK 14 and 16 were wrong: UK 14 bust 96→98, waist 78→80, hips 102→104; UK 16 bust 100→104, waist 82→86, hips 106→110. Hips are Fred Perry's 'Low Hip'. EU uses the France/Belgium/Portugal/Spain row of Fred Perry's conversion chart (Germany/NL/Sweden row is 2 lower: UK 6 = 32). Old /size-guide URL is a 404.
